Every match on 1st of April 2025 |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|N/A|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''April fools 2025''' was a [[Modifiers|modifier]] which randomized multiple parts of the game. It was active in [[Baseplate-L]], [[Baseplate-W]] and in every match on the 1st of April 2025. ==Effects== When activated, '''April fools 2025''' randomized the game for [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. Enemies would have their animations break and certain parts of their body would receive a purple and black checkered texture, representing a lack of textures. They would also change their size and some of their sounds would have its pitch altered. ==Trivia== *The image icon of this modifier is of the third version of the Level 0 [[Demoman]], plastered with a McDonald's burger in where its grenade would be. *The [https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Missing_content purple checkerboard] texture appears to be based on the fallback texture that appears in most game engines. **This texture was first used by the game ''Half-Life 2'' and has since been the standard for missing textures in the [[wp:Source (game engine)|Source]] and [[wp:Source 2|Source 2]] game engine. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0]] **'''April fools 2025''' added. *'''9 April 2025''' - [[v1.60.0]] **'''April fools 2025''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
